desc:
Welcome to Teamwork Obby!

Help your friends help you - press different buttons and access different areas to progress in each obby. There are many 2 player, 3 player and even 4 player level obbies and puzzles to choose from! Train your parkour abilities and reach the final level!

💡How To Play:
- Press the buttons ⬛
- Progress and don't leave anyone behind 🏆
- Reach the END of the levels 🎌
- Get in the Top Leaderboards 🌐
